title: lightly fried spanish cucumber empanadas
description: Fresh, fluffy weeknight Spanish dish featuring cucumber and crispy agemono-deep-fry, low-carb-friendly
instructions: Unroll the whole wheat pastry dough and cut it into 12 equal squares.
In a bowl, mix together the cucumber slices, feta cheese, chopped parsley, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the cucumber mixture in the center of each dough square.
Brush the edges of the dough with olive oil and fold the dough squares in half to form triangles.
Press the edges together with a fork to seal the empanadas.
Heat 1/2 cup of veggie oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F.
Fry 2-3 empanadas at a time for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried empanadas from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the lightly fried Spanish cucumber empanadas warm, garnished with additional chopped parsley if desired.
